Subject: Bridge letter request - Venturo / Redwood (post-report period)

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As part of our procurement and internal audit for our Q2 vendor review, we need a short bridge letter (signed) to cover the period between Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report end date and our current coverage date. A few specifics from our side:

- Your latest SOC 2 Type II report lists the period ending 2026-12-31. We need assurance covering the period up to 2027-05-01.
- The letter doesn't need a full SOC report reissue — a bridge or continuity statement confirming no material control changes and reference to the original report is acceptable.
- We will require a named signatory and a sign date on the letter.
- If you use a template/wording that your auditor (or legal) prefers, please share it so we can route internally.

Also attaching Venturo's standard request form for bridge statements (Venturo-Request-Form-20270514.pdf). Can you confirm:
1) Whether Redwood can provide a signed bridge letter dated within the next two weeks?
2) Who at Redwood will sign (title preferred)?
3) Any evidence or checklist you typically attach (e.g., change log, updated control owner attestations)?

Cc'ing our external reviewer (Oliver Hayes from KPMG) who may have templating suggestions.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Venturo Systems

Daniel — appreciated, and thanks for the clear form.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can provide a signed bridge letter covering 2027-01-01 through 2027-05-01 (or inclusive to the date you need).
- Typical signatory: Laura Bennett, Head of Compliance (or an authorized delegate from Legal if needed).
- Standard attachments we include: a one-page cover letter (bridge wording), a one-page controls summary (changes since report end, if any), and a short attestation checklist signed by control owners.

I've looped in Laura to propose the exact language and Marissa for legal sign-off if the customer needs specific phrasing or auditor-mandated language. Can you confirm whether Venturo needs the bridge to reference a specific SOC report file name or unique report ID? We can also provide the original SOC 2 Type II PDF as part of the bundle (SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026-12.pdf).

Planned timeline: draft today, internal approvals (compliance + legal) by EOD Monday 5/17, signed letter out by Wed 5/19. If that timeline works for Venturo we'll push DocuSign.

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Sales Engineer, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
